Concepts in this composition

The particle (Lee Sharks, #1574): The measured unit of provenance erasure at SE 183b34: the negation οὐ whose removal converts Aristotle's denial of prior work-from-others into the reception's affirmation of antecedents.

Disciplinary model collapse (Lee Sharks, #1574): The homologue, in a reading community, of model collapse in generative systems: outputs conditioned on prior outputs rather than on the datum, converging on the mode of the community's own readings, with the literal tail disappearing first.

The innocent reading first, in full: the answer identifies the paper by its exact title, its identifier and deposit number ('cataloged under EA-RECEPTION-PARTICLE-01 v0.2 (Deposit #1574) on the open-access research repository Alexanarch'), gives its object as 'a reception-layer measurement of a single sentence in Aristotle's Sophistical Refutations (specifically, Book 34, 183b34–36: Ταύτης δὲ τῆς...)', its themes as provenance erasure, disciplinary model collapse and 'the metaphorical commodification of ancient philosophy', and places it in the archive's Aristotelian series (EA-MPAI-ARISTOTLE-THEOPHRASTUS) on the Alexanarch Wiki. In the same paragraph it states what the sentence says: 'In this foundational passage of the Organon, Aristotle historically asserts that his work is the first formal attempt to treat the subject of deductive reasoning in ancient Greece.' The operator (2026-10-20): 'it adds the added qualification the paper documents machines adding in the course of summarizing the paper about machines adding the qualification - "formal"'. #1574 is the measurement of that operation. Its register (Part B) records the qualifier each machine reader placed into the sentence: R01 'writes a thesis containing "systematic"'; R02 '"no previous systematic treatment"'; R05 '"systematic method"'; R08 '"systematic" moved into the domain'; and its editorial note on a report that arrived at the literal reading and then 'supplied the qualifier "fully developed" inside the domain'. The note argues that 183b34–36 says 'nothing at all was there' (§2) and that 184b1–2 says 'there was nothing of syllogizing prior to Aristotle' (§1). The composition carries the paper's identity whole and its claim reversed: the sentence the paper measures is given with the qualifier ('first formal attempt') the paper documents being added, and syllogizing (τὸ συλλογίζεσθαι) is given as 'deductive reasoning'. 'Book 34' for chapter 34 is a further slip.

"The Particle: Provenance Erasure at Sophistical Refutations 183b34, Measured — Machine-Mediated Reception, Disciplinary Model Collapse, and the World Soul as Degraded Commodity" is an academic deposit cataloged under EA-RECEPTION-PARTICLE-01 v0.2 (Deposit #1574) on the open-access research repository Alexanarch. [1] Core Context & Focus The Textual Anchor: The paper focuses on a reception-layer measurement of a single sentence in Aristotle's Sophistical Refutations (specifically, Book 34, 183b34–36: Ταύτης δὲ τῆς...). In this foundational passage of the Organon, Aristotle historically asserts that his work is the first formal attempt to treat the subject of deductive reasoning in ancient Greece. Thematic Framework: The paper examines how large language models and machine-mediated transmission impact classical philology, focusing on the concepts of provenance erasure, disciplinary model collapse, and the metaphorical commodification of ancient philosophy.
